title: Recommended platform for someone on a budget?
author: Spiritual-Lock-612
selftext:
I am kinda broke, but have been really interested in exploring game dev. I've played around a bit with Manus AI, and it has been super fun, but man does it blow through credits, and it gets expensive fast. What other recommendations do you guys have to try out. (Preferably free, but I know that's probably not very feasible for a halfway decent platform).
